data.notes: November 2026 is unusually strong for New Orleans music travel, with a major new riverfront dance festival alongside HBCU band culture, Caribbean carnival, brass-band heritage, and club-scale electronic/R&B shows.

events.title: We Belong Here New Orleans 2026
events.summary: We Belong Here brings its boutique dance-music festival to New Orleans with ODESZA DJ Set, Carl Cox, Steve Angello, Sammy Virji, BLOND:ISH, Max Styler and more. The official event listing confirms November 13–15, 2026 at Goldring/Woldenberg Riverfront Park.

events.title: Pretty Lights - Soundship Space Bus Tour
events.summary: Pretty Lights plays a three-night Soundship Space Bus Tour run at The Fillmore New Orleans, with individual shows listed for November 6, 7 and 8 plus a three-day ticket. The run is a major electronic booking for the month.

events.title: 2026 Bayou Classic Battle of the Bands & Greek Show
events.summary: The Bayou Classic Battle of the Bands & Greek Show brings Southern University’s Human Jukebox and Grambling State’s World Famed Tiger Marching Band into the Superdome on Friday, November 27. It is the signature music component of Bayou Classic weekend.

events.title: Bayou Bacchanal
events.summary: Bayou Bacchanal is New Orleans’ Caribbean Carnival celebration, confirmed for November 7, 2026. The event centers Caribbean culture and heritage with music, dance, parade energy and food traditions.

events.title: 2026 RNB In The Park: Love & Happiness Tour — New Orleans
events.summary: Touring R&B day-festival concept bringing food, vibes and nostalgic R&B energy to Congo Square from noon to 8 PM.

events.title: Beignet Fest 2026
events.venueName: New Orleans City Park Festival Grounds
events.summary: Beignet Fest’s 2026 music lineup features DJ Flowerchild, Imagination Movers, Amanda Shaw, Maggie Koerner and Dragon Smoke at City Park Festival Grounds. The festival is confirmed for Saturday, November 7, 2026.

events.title: Hot 8 Brass Band Sunday Residency — November Dates
events.summary: Grammy-winning New Orleans brass band’s late-Sunday Howlin' Wolf run, a core live brass/funk/jazz nightlife anchor with November listings including the 11/29 show.

events.title: The Dirty Dozen Brass Band
events.summary: Legacy New Orleans brass-band institution plays a Thanksgiving/Bayou Classic weekend Tipitina’s show, a strong pick for travelers chasing the city’s jazz-funk lineage.

events.title: Sober Fest 2026
events.summary: Bridge House / Grace House’s 5th Annual Sober Fest is confirmed for November 21, 2026 at The Broadside. The lineup includes Ivan Neville & Friends, Robin Barnes & The FiyaBirds, Flow Tribe, the School of Rock House Band and Trombone Shorty Foundation Alumni Band.

events.title: RnB Block Party New Orleans
events.summary: RnBnThings’ grown day-party format at 2222 Poydras with DJs, classic/current R&B, food, drinks and a block-party crowd.

events.title: Ravenscoon: The 10th Annual Gobble Wobble
events.summary: Republic NOLA lists Ravenscoon: The 10th Annual Gobble Wobble for November 25, 2026. The Tixr event page describes Ravenscoon as an experimental bass/electronic producer and DJ.

events.title: Thundercat: Distracted AF Tour
events.summary: Thundercat’s Distracted AF Tour is listed for The Fillmore New Orleans on November 5, 2026. The date is a major jazz-fusion, funk and R&B-adjacent concert booking for the month.

events.title: Love In The Club: 2000s Hip-Hop & R&B Dance Party
events.summary: Tipitina’s 18+ 2000s hip-hop and R&B dance party featuring DJ New Era on Bayou Classic weekend.

events.title: A Wild Bleu Night: The Official Alumni Homecoming Party
events.summary: HereWeGo Entertainment’s Dillard homecoming party at the Jazz Market, featuring Lloyd and Partners-N-Crime for an R&B-meets-New Orleans-rap alumni crowd.

events.title: The Big Mike Homecoming Experience
events.summary: Bayou Classic weekend homage to New Orleans-born Southern hip-hop figure OG Big Mike, including a featured live performance at the revived Dew Drop Inn.

events.title: Jon B.
events.summary: House of Blues New Orleans lists R&B singer Jon B. for Friday, November 6, 2026 in the Music Hall. It is one of the month’s stronger R&B club-theater bookings.

events.title: Project Pat
events.summary: House of Blues New Orleans lists Memphis rap figure Project Pat for Saturday, November 28, 2026 in the Music Hall. The booking adds a Southern hip-hop anchor to Bayou Classic weekend.

events.title: Donald Harrison's Quantum Leap Music Fest with The Freakinauts & Rebirth
events.summary: Live Nation lists Donald Harrison’s Quantum Leap Music Fest with The Freakinauts and Rebirth at New Orleans Jazz Market on Sunday, November 1, 2026. The bill points toward New Orleans jazz, funk and brass-band culture.

events.title: The R&B Tour - Starring Usher Raymond & Chris Brown
events.summary: Usher and Chris Brown bring The R&B Tour to Caesars Superdome for two confirmed nights, Friday, November 20 and Saturday, November 21, 2026.

events.title: PJ Morton: Annual Black Friday Show
events.summary: New Orleans native PJ Morton’s Annual Black Friday Show is confirmed at Orpheum Theater New Orleans on Friday, November 27, 2026 at 8:00 PM.

events.title: Tremé Creole Gumbo Festival 2026
events.summary: The New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Foundation confirms Tremé Creole Gumbo Festival for November 14–15, 2026 at Louis Armstrong Park, with two full days of live music, R&B, funk, brass bands, food, and dance.

events.title: Tremé Creole Gumbo Festival
events.summary: Free New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Foundation community festival celebrating Tremé culture with two days of live music, including R&B, funk, brass bands and deep local food culture.

events.title: Buena Vista Orchestra
events.summary: Buena Vista Orchestra is listed for House of Blues New Orleans on Monday, November 16, 2026, bringing Cuban son and Latin repertoire to the French Quarter venue.

events.title: Kurt Vile & the Violators
events.summary: Kurt Vile & the Violators are confirmed at The Joy Theater on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, with Twisted Teens listed on the lineup.

events.title: Buena Vista Orchestra
events.summary: Afro-Cuban and Latin jazz repertoire from the Buena Vista lineage lands at House of Blues, adding a strong Caribbean/Latin diaspora concert option to November’s calendar.

events.title: 10 Years of 6LACK Tour
events.summary: 6LACK’s anniversary tour brings contemporary alt-R&B/hip-hop to the Fillmore with Eem Triplin support, a strong mid-size touring show rather than a stadium headliner.

events.title: Hawthorne Heights - 20th Anniversary of If Only You Were Lonely
events.summary: Hawthorne Heights bring the 20th anniversary tour for If Only You Were Lonely to House of Blues New Orleans, with letlive. and Creeper listed on the bill.

events.title: Fruit Bats
events.summary: Tipitina's Presents lists Fruit Bats for Friday, November 20, 2026, with doors at 7:00 PM and show at 8:00 PM.

events.title: Nick Shoulders
events.summary: Tipitina's Presents confirms Nick Shoulders for Wednesday, November 4, 2026, with doors at 7:00 PM and show at 8:00 PM.
